question: Will the Dallas Cowboys win the 2027 NFL league championship?
description:
This market will resolve according to the team that wins the 2027 NFL league championship. 

If at any point it becomes impossible for a listed team to win the 2027 NFL league championship per the rules of the NFL (e.g., they are eliminated in the playoffs), the corresponding market will resolve to “No”.

If the 2027 NFL league championship game is cancelled, postponed after March 31, 2027 ET, or there is otherwise no winner declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source will be official information from NFL (https://www.nfl.com/); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: The Los Angeles Rams hold the clearest edge in 2027 Super Bowl futures after acquiring two-time Defensive Player of the Year Myles Garrett in a major offseason trade, strengthening an already deep roster anchored by Matthew Stafford. Defending champion Seattle Seahawks sit close behind on the strength of their recent title run, while Buffalo Bills and Baltimore Ravens remain perennial contenders with proven quarterback play and roster continuity. Training-camp injuries have created some roster uncertainty across the league, yet the top tier stays tightly bunched because multiple NFC and AFC clubs enter the 2026 season with comparable talent, coaching stability, and path-to-playoffs profiles. Trader pricing reflects that balance, with no single team viewed as dominant heading into Week 1.
